name: AMASS Brands Inc. Common Stock
summary: AMASS Brands, Inc. develops and distributes a diverse array of botanical-infused items, spanning both alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, alongside personal wellness products. Its beverage selection features various botanical spirits, including dry gin, vodka crafted from botanicals, and unique limited-edition spirits enriched with adaptogenic ingredients. For those seeking alcohol-free options, AMASS offers beverages specifically formulated for social events or personal moments of self-care. The company's personal care line, branded Midori Maison, includes items such as candles, soaps, and hand sanitizers. A core principle across all AMASS products is their composition of solely natural, non-GMO botanical ingredients, deliberately excluding artificial preservatives and superfluous chemicals. The company is committed to providing plant-derived solutions suitable for a broad spectrum of uses, from daily routines to significant celebratory occasions. Established in 2018, AMASS Brands operates out of Los Angeles, California.
